tips.text: Run Kela solo; public squads go badly because randoms do not know the damage phases.
Farm a second Saryn Systems if you also want Saryn; Chroma consumes the first.
Bring Oberon (Smite), Octavia (Mallet), Mesa or Valkyr (Hysteria); each ends a Kela damage phase in seconds.
Carry an Ignis Wraith with punch-through mods to pop the spinning green panels in one sweep.
Switch to your Operator in Void Mode to ignore the orbital strikes; Harrow's Covenant and Limbo also work.
Join a large established clan, buy the Volt Neuroptics blueprint there and leave; the blueprint stays with you.
Bring a Cipher for the Nuovo spy step; its timer is hidden and a fail means a replay.
Walk back and forth through the portal on Ose if enemies will not cross; relog if a mission does not register.
Switch matchmaking to solo if Arid Lancer targets will not spawn, and finish the mission before the third scan counts.
Hit Lech Kril's coolant tubes with Cold procs or Rhino Stomp so they pop reliably.
Build the Ember and Frost parts first; Saryn Systems is usually the last donor you get.
Kill Executioners in the Rathuum arena; they drop Endo often, so the runs are not wasted.
Use Garuda with a Gloom subsume or Ash with Fatal Teleport to kill Executioners quickly.
Kela and the Rathuum arena draw steady complaints, though most players land Saryn Systems within a handful of runs.
Pace Rathuum and Kela at a few runs a day instead of grinding them in one sitting.
